collections.title: SEPA direct debit batches
collections.description: Collect by direct debit: prepare the batch, download the file for the bank and record what was collected and returned in one go.
collections.readOnly: Read-only: a partner prepares, generates and collects the batches.

sequence.FRST: First debit under this mandate (FRST). From the next one on, recurring.
sequence.RCUR: Recurring debit (RCUR): the mandate has already been used in a batch.

copy.failed: It couldn't be copied to the clipboard.

issues.creditorIdUnconfirmed: The creditor identifier (ICS) isn't confirmed with the bank yet: you can prepare the batch and see the file, but not generate it.
issues.creditorIdMissing: The creditor identifier (ICS) is missing, and the issuer has no valid NIF to calculate it from.
issues.creditorIdInvalid: The saved creditor identifier (ICS) isn't valid: check its check digits.
issues.creditorIbanMissing: The account (IBAN) where collections are credited is missing.
issues.creditorIbanInvalid: The creditor's IBAN isn't valid or isn't from a SEPA country.
issues.collectionDatePast: The collection date must be after today.
issues.collectionDateNotBusinessDay: The collection date isn't a banking business day (TARGET2): the bank will move it to the next one.
issues.mandateMissing: The client has no active mandate with this creditor.
issues.mandateNotYetSigned: The mandate was signed after the collection date.
issues.mandateReferenceInvalid: The mandate reference isn't valid for SEPA.
issues.debtorNameMissing: The account holder is missing from the mandate.
issues.debtorIbanNotSepa: The mandate's IBAN isn't from a SEPA country.
issues.amountNotPositive: Nothing is left to collect on this invoice.
issues.amountTooLarge: The amount exceeds the maximum for a SEPA debit.

validation.creditorId: Invalid creditor identifier: check the format (ES + 2 digits + suffix + NIF) and the check digits.
validation.creditorIdRequired: To confirm it, type the creditor identifier.
validation.iban: Invalid IBAN or outside the SEPA area
validation.ibanNotSepa: This IBAN isn't from a SEPA country: it can't be used for direct debit.
validation.mandateReference: Up to 35 characters: unaccented letters, numbers and - / ? : ( ) . , ' +, no spaces.
validation.futureDate: It can't be a future date

creditor.title: Creditor details
creditor.description: Which identifier (ICS) and which account each issuer uses to collect its debits.
creditor.howToGet: How to get the ICS: sign up for the SEPA direct debit service (Cuaderno 19.14) with your bank. The bank confirms your creditor identifier; it's usually the one we calculate from the NIF. In the meantime, you can record mandates, prepare batches and see the file, but not generate it.
creditor.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the creditor details.
creditor.sheetDescription: What goes in each of this issuer's batch files. Anything you leave empty is taken from the issuer.
creditor.name: Creditor name
creditor.noTaxId: This issuer has no NIF: add it in Settings → Issuers or type the ICS your bank gives you.
creditor.proposedHint: Calculated from the NIF — confirm it with your bank.
creditor.creditorIdHint: The one your bank gave you. Empty: the one derived from the NIF is still suggested.
creditor.confirmedHint: Batches are only generated with a confirmed ICS. The bank gives it to you when you sign up for SEPA direct debits (Cuaderno 19.14).
creditor.ibanHint: The account where the bank credits the batches. Empty: the issuer's IBAN.
creditor.bicHint: Optional since 2016: without it, the file marks it as not provided.

list.title: Batches
list.description: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# batch} other {# batches}}
list.emptyBody: Prepare the first one: choose the issuer and the collection date, and overdue direct debit invoices are preselected.

new.title: New batch
new.description: Choose the creditor and the day the bank should charge the debits.
new.hint: Invoices due by that date with direct debit as the payment method and an active mandate are preselected. You can add or remove any of them before generating the file.

editor.title: Batch for {date}
editor.subtitle: Creditor: {issuer}
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? Its invoices become free for another batch.
editor.collectionOnHint: The day the bank charges the debits.
editor.notesPlaceholder: Just for you; they don't go in the file
editor.creditorHelp: Creditor details are changed in <link>Batches → Creditor details</link> (owners only).
editor.rowsDescription: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices from this issuer can be direct debited} one {# invoice can be direct debited} other {# invoices can be direct debited}} · outstanding amounts incl. VAT
editor.emptyBody: This issuer has no outstanding issued invoices with direct debit as the payment method, nor clients with an active mandate.
editor.addMandate: Record the mandate on the client's page
editor.footer: {count, plural, =0 {No debits} one {# debit} other {# debits}} · {amount}

blocked.creditor: To generate the file, the ICS must be confirmed with the bank.
blocked.items: {count, plural, one {# debit has} other {# debits have}} problems: fix or remove them.

editor.generateHint: Generates the pain.008 file to upload to the bank. After that it can't be edited (unless it goes back to draft before being sent).

preview.title: File preview
preview.description: {count, plural, one {# debit} other {# debits}} · {amount}. Nothing is saved.
preview.unconfirmed: Preview with an unconfirmed ICS: don't upload this file to the bank. Confirm it in the creditor details and generate the final one.
preview.excluded: {count, plural, one {# invoice is left out} other {# invoices are left out}} because of their warnings.

view.title: Batch for {date}
view.markSentConfirm: Have you already uploaded the file to your bank? After this it can't go back to draft.
view.revertConfirm: The file is discarded and the batch can be edited again. Only do this if you haven't uploaded it to the bank.
view.revertedToast: The batch is back in draft
view.settleConfirm: The bank has credited the batch: a direct debit payment is recorded on each invoice that wasn't returned ({count, plural, one {# debit} other {# debits}}, {amount}).
view.settledToast: {count, plural, =0 {Batch collected} one {Batch collected: # payment recorded} other {Batch collected: # payments recorded}}

banner.generated: Download the file and upload it to your bank's online banking (SEPA direct debits, Core scheme). Then mark it as sent.
banner.sent: When the bank credits the batch (on {date} or shortly after), mark it as collected. If the bank notifies you of returned debits, record them on each one first.
banner.settled: Collected on {date}. If a client later returns a debit (they have up to 8 weeks), record it on its line: the invoice becomes outstanding again.

view.itemsDescription: What the file says: amount, mandate, sequence and reference of each debit.
view.returnDescription: The bank didn't charge this debit: when the batch is collected it won't be recorded, and the invoice will remain outstanding.
view.returnDescriptionSettled: A negative payment (the return) is recorded and the invoice becomes outstanding again.
view.returnCodeHint: The code shown on the return notice.
view.returnReasonPlaceholder: What the bank or the client told you
view.undoConfirm: Undo the return? The debit counts as pending collection in this batch again.
view.undoConfirmSettled: Undo the return? The debit counts as collected again, and its invoice as paid.

returnCodes.MS02: Refused by the client without a reason
returnCodes.AG01: The account doesn't accept direct debits
returnCodes.MS03: Refused by the bank without a reason
returnCodes.SL01: Specific service of the client's bank

mandates.title: SEPA direct debit
mandates.summaryNone: No mandate: their invoices can't be direct debited.
mandates.empty: Record the SEPA mandate signed by the client to collect from them by direct debit.
mandates.sheetDescription: The signed authorization allowing you to charge debits to the client's account. Keep the signed document: the bank may ask for it if the client makes a claim.
mandates.collections: {count, plural, one {# debit} other {# debits}} · last on {date}
mandates.creditorNotReady: This creditor doesn't have a confirmed ICS yet: the mandate is valid, but nothing can be collected until it's confirmed in <link>Batches</link>.
mandates.revokeConfirm: Revoke this mandate? Their invoices can't be direct debited until you record another one.
mandates.deleteConfirm: Delete this mandate? Only do this if you recorded it by mistake: it has never been in a batch.
mandates.locked: This mandate has already been used in a batch: its details can't change. To change the account, revoke it and record another one.
mandates.issuerHint: The issuer that collects the debits.
mandates.issuerNotReady: This issuer doesn't have a confirmed ICS yet: you'll be able to record the mandate, but not generate batches until it's confirmed.
mandates.referenceHint: Unique for this creditor. The suggested one works; if the paper mandate has a different one, use that.
mandates.debtorNameHint: Exactly as it appears at the client's bank.
mandates.notesPlaceholder: Where the signed document is, contact person…

transfer.title: Payment by bank transfer
transfer.noIban: The invoice doesn't include the issuer's IBAN: add it in Settings → Issuers for future invoices.

sepa.title: SEPA direct debit
sepa.noMandate: The client has no active mandate with this issuer: record it on their <link>page</link> to direct debit this invoice.
sepa.notInRemittance: It isn't in any open batch.

payments.fromRemittanceHint: It comes from a SEPA batch: it can't be deleted here. If the bank returned it, record the return in the batch.

notFound.title: Batch not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the link may belong to another organization.

errors.remittanceNotDraft: This batch already has its file: move it back to draft to change it.
errors.remittanceNotGenerated: The file has to be generated first.
errors.remittanceNotSent: The batch has to be marked as sent to the bank first.
errors.remittanceNotSettled: A batch's payments are recorded when it's marked as collected.
errors.remittanceLocked: A batch sent to the bank can no longer be changed or deleted.
errors.remittanceChanged: The batch changed while you were reviewing it (payments, mandates or amounts): reload it and review it again.
errors.invoiceInOpenRemittance: One of the invoices is already in another uncollected batch.
errors.invoiceNotCollectible: Only issued invoices (not corrective ones) from the batch's issuer can be direct debited.
errors.collectionDatePast: The collection date must be after today.
errors.settleDateInvalid: The credit date can't be in the future.
errors.returnDateInvalid: The return date can't be in the future.
errors.mandateInUse: This mandate has already been used in a batch: revoke it and record another one instead of changing or deleting it.
errors.mandateInvalid: The mandate doesn't belong to this client with this creditor.
errors.mandateReferenceTaken: There's already a mandate with that reference for this creditor (revoked ones count too).
errors.mandateActiveExists: The client already has an active mandate with this creditor: revoke it before recording another one.
errors.creditorIdTaken: Another issuer already uses that creditor identifier.
errors.creditorUnconfirmed: The creditor identifier (ICS) still needs to be confirmed with the bank. Sign up for SEPA direct debits (Cuaderno 19.14) and confirm it in the creditor details.
errors.previewUnavailable: No preview is possible: check the warnings (creditor identifier, receiving account or debits).
errors.cannotGenerate: Check the warnings for the batch and its debits before generating the file.
errors.fileFailed: The file couldn't be saved. Please try again.
